attributes.name: Invoice Number
attributes.description: Extract the unique Invoice Number. If an invoice number is not clearly visible or cannot be found, return a blank value. Do not guess or invent a number.

attributes.name: Client Name
attributes.description: Extract the Client Name. If a Client Name is not clearly visible or cannot be found, return a blank value. Do not guess or invent a name.

attributes.name: Client Email Address
attributes.description: Extract the client's email address. If no email address is present on the document, return a blank value.

attributes.name: Client KRA PIN
attributes.description: The Kenya Revenue Authority(KRA) Personal Identification Number(PIN) for the client. Should be an 11-character alphanumeric string, strictly starting with the letter 'P' and ending with a letter, (e.g., P0XXXXXXXXZ). If the KRA PIN cannot be found, return a blank value. Do not guess or invent a number.

attributes.name: Sub Total
attributes.description: The total cost of all items combined before taxes are added. Extract the numeric value only.  If the Sub Total cannot be found, return a blank value. Do not guess or invent a number.

attributes.name: VAT Rate
attributes.description: The applicable Value Added Tax(VAT) rate expressed as a percentage. The standard rate in Kenya is 16%.  If the VAT rate cannot be found, return a blank value. Do not guess or invent a percentage.

attributes.name: VAT Amount
attributes.description: The specific tax value, calculated from the subtotal. Extract the numeric value only.  If the VAT Amount cannot be found, return a blank value. Do not guess or invent a number.

attributes.name: Total
attributes.description: The final grand total. This is the sum of the subtotal plus the VAT amount. Extract the numeric value only.  If the Total cannot be found, return a blank value. Do not guess or invent a number.

attributes.name: Issue Date
attributes.description: Extract the date the invoice was issued or created. Format the output strictly as YYYY-MM-DD (e.g., 2026-05-21). If the date on the invoice is written in text like 'May 21, 2026', convert it to 2026-05-21. If no clear issue date can be found on the document, return a blank value. Do not guess or use the current date.

attributes.name: Due Date
attributes.description:
Extract the final payment due date. Format the output strictly as YYYY-MM-DD.

If the due date is explicitly stated (e.g., 'Due Date: June 20, 2026'), convert and return it as 2026-06-20.

If the document says 'Due upon receipt' or 'Due Immediately', use the extracted Invoice Issue Date as the Due Date.

If the document specifies terms like 'Net 30' or 'Payment due within 30 days', calculate the date by adding those days to the extracted Invoice Issue Date.

If no due date or payment terms are mentioned anywhere on the invoice, return a blank value. Do not guess.
